title: Big Summer
author: Allan Wiedenfeld
description:
“Everything is symbolic.”


In the spring of 1989, eighteen-year-old Allan Wiedenfeld began keeping a journal. He wrote about nearly everything: friendship and jealousy, sex and death, family and religion, books and bad decisions, McDonald’s and laundromats, Wisconsin and the places beyond it he imagined might contain another kind of life.


Over the next five months, the entries become the record of a life quietly changing shape. High school ends. His family grows more unstable. His younger brother gets into increasingly serious trouble. A trip to New York becomes a secret. Friendships intensify into something harder to define. And a relationship with another boy begins to force questions Allan can describe on the page long before he knows what to do with them.


Big Summer is a serialized memoir drawn from that journal, preserving the intelligence, absurdity, anxiety and startling intimacy of the original voice.


This isn’t 1989 remembered from a distance. It’s 1989 while it was still happening.

description:

We're swapping rigid, outdated life advice for real talk on figuring out who you are while navigating the absolute chaotic circus of your twenties and beyond.
What We're Actually Talking About:
•	Career & Financial Survival: Dealing with corporate jargon, navigating quarter-life crisis job pivots, and learning how to budget without deleting your delivery apps.
•	Relationships & Dating: Navigating talking stages, setting boundaries, maintaining genuine friendships post-grad, and dodging walking red flags.

description:
When Elizabeth Ann arrives at her new home on the Putney farm, she quickly discovers that life in the countryside is nothing like the sheltered existence she left behind. Nicknamed 'Betsy,' this 9 year old orphan faces the challenge of adapting to a family and a lifestyle that her city relatives deemed unconventional. The Putneys believe in letting children learn through experience, a concept that shakes Betsy's understanding of safety and rules.

As Betsy navigates her new surroundings, she encounters a world filled with farm chores, wild adventures, and unexpected friendships. Will she embrace the freedom of her new life, or will the shadow of her past hold her back? With each challenge, from learning to care for animals to understanding the rhythms of rural life, Betsy uncovers her own strengths and talents.

Dorothy Canfield Fisher's 'Understood Betsy' explores themes of resilience, self-discovery, and the importance of community. This timeless tale not only captivates young listeners but offers valuable lessons on growth and courage. Join Betsy on her journey as she learns what it truly means to be understood, and discover how the lessons of the past can shape our futures in surprising ways. title: Full Recovery Is Possible with Lily Thrope
author: Lily Thrope
description:
Lily Thrope wants you to know that when it comes to disordered eating in teens, full recovery is completely possible.
Before parents find themselves on a call with one of Thrope Therapy's clinicians, they start noticing signs that concern them, often over the course of months:
1. Their teen may start speaking more negatively about bodies: theirs or others'
2. Their eating habits might change
3. They may be becoming more rigid with exercise
4. They might be showing other signs of anxiety or depression
But parents often think: "I'm just overreacting," "It's a phase," "She eats plenty at home," or "Surely, the pediatrician would have flagged it if something was wrong."
But eating disorders don't always present in the ways parents expect.
In this series, Lily Thrope dives into everything parents need to know to get their teens the help they need before the "little things" become big ones.
You'll learn:
1. The most surprising signs of eating disorders in teens
2. The most dangerous myths and misconceptions about disordered eating most people don't realize
3. How eating disorders present differently in teen girls vs. teen boys
4. How eating disorders affect teens in larger bodies at staggering rates, and why they get missed
5. How to cope with the emotions that come up for parents who worked so hard to "do everything right"
6. How to talk to your teen about your concerns, even if they're denying there's something wrong
7. What therapy can look like for eating disorder recovery

description:
If you walked away from the pews, you aren't lost—you might just be right where the truth was all along.

For centuries, institutional religion taught us that God only lives inside the sanctuary walls, behind the pulpit, and under their rules. But when Jesus was executed, it wasn't in the inner courts of power. It was out in the dirt, outside the city gate, alongside the castaways and outcasts.

As Hebrews 13:13 says: "Let us go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore."

Being outside the camp doesn't mean your faith died; it means you outgrew the control. It means you’d rather sit in the desert with real questions than sit in a comfortable seat pretending you have all the institutional answers.

Outside the Camp is a space for the thinkers, the wandering, and anyone hungry for unvarnished scripture and real history—free from church politics and human dogma.

Pull up a chair. You’re right where you belong.

description: Dark Silk is a true crime storytelling channel uncovering real crime cases, unsolved mysteries, historical crimes, and modern investigations from across Asia. Each episode explores missing persons cases, cold cases, and lesser-known crimes rarely covered in English-speaking media.

title: The Weekly Check- In
author: Sofia and Tess
description: Hosted by Sofia and Tess, The Weekly Check-In is your weekly dose of laughter and deep conversations. What started as a friendship during a Yoga Teacher Training in Aruba, between a Brazilian and a Swede became a ritual of checking in across time zones. Each episode dives into life's highs, lows, and everything in between: identity, relationships, grief, culture, and growth. With honesty, curiosity, and the occasional existential crisis, we're here to remind you that whatever you're going through, someone else is probably going through it too. Join us while we figure out life together.

title: Crimes Anatomy - True Crime Cases
author: Anatomy - True Crime Cases
description:
The one and only Crimes Anatomy.
I study the darkness so you don’t have too

Narrating true crime stories I research and write.

title: Short Morbid Stories
author: Halter E. Frank
description:
Welcome to Short Morbid Stories, the podcast where your darkest nightmares not only come to life but stick around long enough to make you question your life choices. Each episode delivers a spine-chilling, heart-pounding tale that dives deep into the macabre, the morose, and the mildly inconvenient (if you're afraid of sleeping again).

From haunted houses and sinister spirits to gruesome mysteries and existential dread, these horrific stories will keep you on the edge of your seat—and maybe under your bed. Perfect for those who like their daily dose of horror, Short Morbid Stories promises to satisfy your cravings for the horrifying, the supernatural, and the downright unsettling.

So, turn off the lights, put on your headphones, and prepare to be unnerved. Welcome to a world where every story is a journey into the morbidly fantastic. 

Listen, if you dare…

title: English Chat
author: FRANCISCO DE SOUSA
description:
🎙️ Stop Translating. Start Thinking in English.
You understand English — but freeze when it's time to speak. That's not a language problem. It's a brain problem.
Sarah & Mike use psychology and brain science to rewire how you learn English. No textbooks. No grammar drills. Just methods that train your brain to think in English naturally.
🧠 Stop translating in your head
🗣️ Real conversations
📖 20+ words per episode
📄 Free PDF transcript
For intermediate learners (B1–B2) who know English but can't use it confidently yet.
Press play. Let your brain do the work. 💛

title: Business School
author: Synchrony
description: Entrepreneurs don't graduate, we just keep learning. This is Business Schooled, where we sit down with entrepreneurs who learned the hard way. No textbooks. No theory. Just valuable lessons, learned on the job.

title: The ClubStats Community Cricket Podcast
author: ClubStats.cricket
description: The ClubStats Community Cricket Podcast celebrates Australian community Cricket clubs and the players, volunteers, records and achievements that shape the grassroots game. Hosted by ClubStats founder Anthony Spiteri, each episode goes inside a club to uncover its history, premierships, milestones, characters and untold stories. From the scorebook to the on field legends. Follow for authentic stories from community cricket across Australia.

title: The Organic Reflection Podcast
author: Organic Reflection
description:
Not everything we've been told about health, healing, and happiness is true.
So we question it.
Organic Reflection is a space for raw, honest conversations, the kind that shift how you think, feel, and live. We go to the places most people won't. The messy parts. The breakthroughs. The things people carry quietly for years before they finally say them out loud.
If you've ever felt like there's more to life than what you've been given, you'll feel at home here. 🙏🏽🤍

title: Two Sober Dudes Podcast
author: Two Sober Dudes
description: Two Sober Dudes is an honest, funny and unfiltered podcast about sobriety, recovery, relationships, family, music, real life and everything in between. Tony and Zach share their own experiences and sit down with friends and guests to talk about what life can look like without alcohol — with plenty of laughs and zero preaching.

title: Five Pathways To Self-Mastery
author: Melanated Law®
description:
You survived the family and toxic systems that were supposed to protect you. Now it's time to build the self they tried to bury.
If you grew up in a home shaped by narcissism, religious control, or emotional manipulation, if you learned to shrink yourself, anticipate danger, and earn love through performance… you did not escape unscathed. You escaped with a nervous system wired for threat, an identity built around other people's needs, and a gap where your authentic self was supposed to grow.

title: Bring the Kingdom
author: Scott Roper
description: Bring the Kingdom goes beyond the surface of Scripture through deep biblical study, historical and cultural context, theology, prophecy, and the ancient worldview of the biblical writers. We explore the threads that run from Genesis to Revelation, including difficult, unusual, and often overlooked passages, with a focus on understanding Scripture in its original context and applying its message faithfully today.

title: Post Pilates Thoughts
author: Post Pilates Thoughts
description:
Three friends come together for honest conversations, plenty of laughs, and real-life reflections. Each episode explores life, friendship, and relationships through the lens of twenty-somethings navigating adulthood for the first time. From lighthearted moments to meaningful discussions, we talk about the topics that feel familiar, relatable, and real.
New episodes drop every Thursday 🤍

title: Rediscovering Authentic Christianity
author: George Kouri
description: Join Dr. George Kouri on the Rediscovering Authentic Christianity podcast as he explores what it means to follow Jesus with biblical truth, genuine faith, and Spirit-empowered living.

title: SuperTalks by SuperAcademy
author: Lauren MacKinnon
description:
Raising confident kids in a fast-changing world starts with better conversations.
SuperTalks is a podcast by SuperAcademy for parents, educators, and anyone invested in helping young people thrive in the next decade. Hosted by Lauren, the series explores what kids really need right now - not just more confidence, but a stronger sense of identity, emotional regulation, self-awareness, communication, belonging, and purpose.
Visit us to learn more: https://mysuperacademy.com/
Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_superacademy
Through conversations with experts, leaders, entrepreneurs, and changemakers, SuperTalks looks at the future of childhood, leadership, AI, social media, friendship, and the human skills that will matter most.
At the heart of every episode is one powerful question: what helps a young person discover who they are and what they're capable of?
Because every child has a superpower. Our job is to help them see it.
Join the SuperAcademy World and sign up to our newletter: eepurl.com/jhcvEc
Discover IRL Workshops: https://mysuperacademy.com/pages/superacademy-workshops
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_superacademy

title: Habits of the Heart with Dr. Gabriela Grasso
author: Gabriela Grasso
description:
Habits of the Heart with Dr. Gabriela Grasso is where behavioral science meets Biblical truth—helping us move from knowing truth to living it.


Hosted by Dr. Gabriela Grasso, a licensed educator, Board Certified Behavior Analyst, and lifelong learner, this podcast explores the space between what we know, what we believe, and how we actually live.

Through Biblical truth, practical teaching, behavioral insight, personal stories, and real-life application, each episode helps you understand the patterns that shape everyday life and turn what you believe into intentional action.


Because knowing something is not the same as living it.


Together, we'll explore faith, identity, behavior, personal growth, purpose, relationships, resilience, and the everyday habits that shape who we are becoming.


This isn't about practicing to earn your identity or God's love. It's about learning to live from the truth and identity you've already received.


Spirit First. Mind Next. Body Follows.


One truth at a time, we'll move from understanding to practice—and from knowing truth to living it.


Educate. Elevate. Empower.

title: Leaving the Shadows
author: Chandler Grace
description: Open & honest talk about recovery — without filters. Leaving the Shadows shares personal experience, strength, hope, and occasional struggles around recovery from pornography addiction and other addictive behaviors. With a focus on practical tools, 12-step principles, sponsorship, meetings, daily inventory, and building a sustainable life, this podcast exists to remind listeners they are not alone.

title: Political Views From The Short Side
author: Austin vicknair
description:
Welcome to Political Views From The Short Side.
I am the host Austin Vicknair, on the show I will have guests and will talk about the latest political headlines.

title: Dharma & Drama
author: Ali
description: The Ramayana movie is here — and it's got everything: an epic story, a massive cast, and no shortage of drama. Dharma & Drama covers it all, week by week. Trailer breakdowns. Casting controversies. Box office battles. Real talk on what's working and what isn't — no fanboy filter, no fluff. We go deeper too: the dharma at the heart of the story, the choices that shaped an epic, and why Ram's tale still matters today. Part film show, part mythology deep-dive. New episodes every Friday. Full coverage at ramayanafilm.online

title: Adaptive Commercial Leadership
author: Tevfik Tolga Kavun
description: Adaptive Commercial Leadership explores how artificial intelligence, data, and modern management practices are reshaping commercial leadership and decision-making. Hosted by Tevfik Tolga Kavun, the podcast examines practical approaches to field leadership, coaching, territory management, organizational learning, and AI-enabled decision support, with a particular focus on pharmaceutical and commercial organizations.

title: Visible By Design with Lindsay Sullivan
author: Visible By Design
description:
You’re great at what you do. It’s time more people knew it.
Visible By Design is the podcast for entrepreneurs ready to stop being the best-kept secret in their industry and become known for what they do.
Hosted by visibility strategist Lindsay Sullivan, the show explores how to build a business that gets seen, remembered, and chosen—from the strategy behind your visibility to the confidence required to actually put it into action.
Because doing great work isn’t enough if no one knows you’re there.

title: Sound Mantra
author: Gabriella Wright
description: Welcome to Sound Mantra, where host Gabriella Wright interviews artists about the relationship between creativity, vulnerability and mental health. This space is all about connection through creative expression and slowing down enough to talk about what's really going on beneath the surface. Our mission is to shed light on the best mantras in life, the ones that carry us through dark times and aluminate the path ahead. We're grateful to be on this journey with you — one breath, one story, one song at a time.

title: Before You Install That FF Panel
author: Tiwari
description: A download promising easier gameplay can carry consequences that aren't visible on the download button. https://brutalpanel.com/ examines questionable Free Fire panels and unofficial Android files from a security perspective, helping players understand what they may be risking before installing anything.

title: A Little More with Letícia
author: Letícia Quintal | Another Level
description:
A little more about me. A little more English for you.
Welcome to my audio journal! I’m Letícia, an English teacher, mother, language learner, International Trade student, and founder of Another Level Language School.
In each episode, I share a little piece of my life: personal stories, everyday moments, memories, and things I’m still figuring out.
As you get to know me, you’ll practice listening to English and explore useful vocabulary and expressions, with simple explanations woven into each conversation.
You don’t need to understand every word. Follow the story, get curious, and listen again whenever you like.
Real life. Everyday English. A little more, one episode at a time.

Feelings in Shadow — After Dark

title: The Price of your Life
author: Hayat Essakkati
description: Whether you're buying your first home, relocating, or started hiring, every big decision comes with a price no one warns you about. In The Price of Your Life, Hayat Essakkati sits down with people who've lived these moments and talks honestly about what they cost, not just in money, but in the choices, beliefs and habits underneath them. Because money is never only about numbers; it's about how we were raised, what we value, and the things we're afraid to ask. Every decision has a price nobody tells you about. What's yours?

title: The Evolved Healer
author: Tracey Gillies
description:
Tracey explores the hidden signs of demonic and multidimensional interference, including intrusive thoughts, spiritual disconnection, recurring chaos, negative manifestation patterns, and the healing cycles that keep people stuck. She unpacks how trauma, energetic attachments, and fractured sovereignty leave people vulnerable to deeper interference. Every episode covers spiritual sovereignty, energetic healing, empath protection, soul alignment, multidimensional consciousness, and reclaiming personal power. 
Learn more: http://www.traceygillies.com

title: No Label Needed
author: Gabriel Comfort
description: No Label Needed is a music podcast for artists, creators, and anyone who refuses to fit inside a box.Hosted by Bonni3, the show covers artist spotlights, interviews, music trends, industry advice, music marketing, creativity, and the realities of building a career in music—without the industry jargon or fake rules.From emerging artists and their stories to the trends shaping music today, No Label Needed is about the people creating their own lane and making noise without waiting for someone else to give them a label.No labels. No boxes. Just music, culture, creativity, and the people pushing it forward. 🎙️🔥

title: A Manifesto of Fruitfulness: Stories
author: Church of the City New York
description:
New York disciples its people through ambition. Etched into the walls of Moynihan Train Hall, the newly renovated front door to the city, is a single word from the New York State seal: Excelsior. It's Latin for "ever upward," and while meant as civic pride showcasing New York's history of excellence, said honestly, in the context of most people's lives in the city, "ever upward" feels more like a mandate than a cheer.
Most people here live pinned between two unsatisfying options—apathy or ambition—with both ending in defeat.
Jesus offers a third way: fruitfulness. He makes the uncomfortable contrast between what a person produces and what a person's life produces in somebody else, and in turn, the Kingdom.
Over eleven weeks, we will hear about the 100x life God intends to cultivate in His disciples.

title: Table Talk with Pastor Shay

Two hosts break down what local physiotherapists, chiropractors and orthotics clinics are seeing day to day: custom orthotics and bracing, physio and rehab, massage and acupuncture, and what to expect from treatment. New episodes every week.

title: Vedic Stars & Planets
author: nk swami
description: Explore the fascinating world of Vedic astrology through the stars, planets, zodiac signs, nakshatras, and houses. Each episode explores traditional Jyotisha concepts, planetary symbolism, birth charts, celestial cycles, and the ancient knowledge surrounding astrology. Discover the principles and traditions that have shaped the study of Vedic astrology across generations.

title: On Point with Navion
author: Navion
description:
Pharmacy is one of the fastest-growing costs on any health plan, and the hardest to see. PBM contracts, rebate structures, specialty drugs, and GLP-1s are reshaping plan economics faster than organizations can track.

In On Point with Navion, you'll find practical, plain-language insights on the decisions that move the needle most: PBM strategy and contract reviews, rebates, specialty cost containment, GLP-1 coverage, formulary design, and how pharmacy strategy changes across fully insured, level-funded, and self-funded plans. Whether you're overseeing a pharmacy benefit, advising clients or managing a health plan, our goal is simple: help you understand the market, ask the right questions, and make decisions you can stand behind.

Whether you're overseeing a pharmacy benefit, advising clients or managing a health plan, our goal is simple: help you understand the market, ask the right questions, and make decisions you can stand behind.

title: Christian music
author: Robert Wright
description:
Christian Music by Robert Wright Christian Music by Robert Wright delivers uplifting worship, faith-filled lyrics, and messages of hope rooted in God's Word. Every song is created to encourage believers, inspire hearts, and draw listeners closer to Jesus Christ through the power of music and worship. Through contemporary Christian sounds and meaningful biblical messages, Robert Wright's music seeks to glorify God, strengthen faith, and remind people of God's love, grace, and promises. Mission:
Sharing God's Light Through Music. Tagline:
Faith • Hope • Worship Scripture:
"Let there be light." Genesis 1:3 This description pairs very well with your modern neon logo and gives your ministry a professional Christian music brand identity.

title: The Sunrise Meets Podcast
author: Luis Chavez and Anthony Hernandez
description: Just a podcast with where I get people to confess their most inner thoughts, discuss pop-culture, and dissect our own contentious relationship with the world and anything that comes to mind. Welcome to The Sunrise Meets Podcast. New episodes drop every Sunday!

title: Made with Patience
author: The Premier Design Haus
description:
Made with Patience
The honest podcast for creatives who are building something real.
Hosted by Patience Walton — Creative Director, design educator, and entrepreneur — Made with Patience gets into the conversations the design industry isn't having out loud. Career. Mindset. Art. Design. Business. And everything in between.
No highlight reels. No perfect answers.

title: Kelly Whooo?
author: Kelly Jones
description:
You may know my name. You don’t know my whole story.


Welcome to Kelly Whooo? - a podcast about life, love, lessons, laughter, and all the versions of ourselves we become along the way. 


I’m Kelly, and I’ve been a soldier, a wife, a mother, a business owner, a friend, and a woman who has learned that life rarely goes exactly according to plan. And at this great age, I’m still discovering who I am - and who I’m becoming.


Each episode brings real stories and honest conversations about marriage, motherhood, friendships, family, major weight loss, business, reinvention, getting older, starting over, and those moments that make you stop and ask, “Wait…whooo am I now?”


Sometimes it’ll be funny. Sometimes it’ll get personal. Sometimes we may go somewhere I didn’t expect.


Because this isn’t a podcast about having life figured out.


It’s about having lived enough life to finally tell the stories.


This is Kelly Whooo?


And trust me-you don’t know the whole store yet.

title: Valmiki Ramayana for kids
author: Sireesha Rachamalla
description:
What if the Ramayana wasn’t just an ancient story, but a guide to the little challenges children face every day?
Valmiki Ramayana for Kids brings timeless stories to life through engaging storytelling, fascinating characters, and simple lessons children can relate to. Each episode ends with a meaningful takeaway—connecting the wisdom of Rama, Sita, Hanuman, and others to everyday experiences like friendship, courage, kindness, emotions, honesty, and making the right choices.
Come along on a beautiful journey where ancient stories meet a child’s world!

title: Things to Do in Western Mass
author: Things to Do in Western Mass
description: Discover what’s happening across Western Massachusetts, with a focus on Amherst, Northampton and the surrounding Pioneer Valley. Each episode explores events, day trips, local history, culture, food, outdoor adventures, seasonal traditions and places worth discovering. Whether you live here, are visiting for the weekend or are planning a Western Mass getaway, we’ll help you find something interesting to do—and tell you a little of the story behind it.

title: The Maine Shift
author: Maine Forté
description: The Main Shift is a podcast about perspective, purpose, and personal transformation. Through meaningful conversations and shared experiences, we explore the mindset shifts that help people grow through life's transitions and become who they're meant to be.

title: Inside Ulster Hockey
author: Ayeisha McFerran
description:
Inside Ulster Hockey is the home of hockey stories from across the province. 
From players and coaches to officials, volunteers, clubs, and schools, we bring you the voices, insights, and experiences that shape our game. 
Join us each episode as we celebrate the people behind the sport. 
Our Game. Our Stories.

title: The Slow Archive
author: Owen Barnes
description: A history of ordinary things, told slowly. Each episode is an hour of calm, factual narration about something everyday: lighthouses, salt, the postal service, canals, clocks, libraries. How people managed before it, how it came to be, how it worked, what became of it. Short sentences, slow pace, no cliffhangers, no questions. You are not meant to follow along; falling asleep is the idea. Every episode ends in silence, not an ad. Chapter timestamps are in each episode's notes. Written by Owen Barnes and narrated with AI.

title: WSL Review
author: Jack Chedzey
description:
This is a weekly show where Jack and Kevin discuss all things related to The WSL and WSL2!
We will discuss transfer stories, blockbuster matches, as well as give our opinions and rankings on various topics!

title: Celebritea Blinds
author: Celebritea Blinds
description:
Welcome to The Celebritea Blinds Podcast, where we uncover the untold stories behind the biggest names in entertainment.
Each episode takes a deep dive into one celebrity’s blind items from the past—revisiting the rumors, whispers, and behind-the-scenes allegations that had everyone talking.
We’ll connect the dots between past rumors and what we know today, piece together the timeline, and see which blinds aged surprisingly well—and which ones didn’t. Everything said is alleged and for entertainment purposes only.

title: Talking Notes: The Rig, The Road, The Reckoning
author: Nick Robinson and Adam Hollier
description:
The Rig, The Road, The Reckoning, honest, first-hand interviews with working musicians about the real life of the job, the stuff that never makes the highlight reel.
We sit down with session players, bandleaders, musical directors, teachers and touring pros, and ask the questions most people skip: how the work actually comes in, how the money really adds up, what the job does to your body and your mind, where AI fits, and what they make of it all looking back.
New episodes at talkingnotes.co.uk

title: The Camp Ember Podcast
author: Camp Ember
description: Welcome to the Camp Ember Podcast, where a Brit and a Texan share the stories, laughs, and lessons of life at summer camp. Whether you’re a first-time counselor, a camp veteran, or simply curious about camp life, each episode is packed with practical advice, unforgettable stories, cultural differences, and honest conversations. Pull up a chair by the campfire as we help you survive and thrive at summer camp, taking a spark and creating a flame.

title: What is Life? w/ Tiff + Cody
author: What is Life Podcast
description:
What Is Life? is a podcast about asking the questions none of us really have the answers to.
Tiff + Cody explore love, friendship, belief, marriage, parenting, sex, money, identity, spirituality and everything in between with curiosity, honesty, and a willingness to admit when we have absolutely no idea.
This isn’t a podcast about having life figured out. It’s about questioning what we thought we knew, sharing what we’ve learned along the way, and figuring it out together.
Real, raw, vulnerable, and hopefully really effing fun.
We don’t know either. Let’s talk about it. 🎙️

author: Pim and Milan
description:
She was a Google leader; he was a stay-at-home dad 6 years her junior. 3 kids under 8. 0 screens. 0 fights. We threw out the default script.
Welcome to huMAN UP with Pim and Milan.
After Wall Street and Google, we built our business (Grows Us), retreat center (La Tierra), and AI app (JustRight). Today, we live screen-free in Chiang Mai, homeschool, work side-by-side as best friends, and operate with (almost) zero friction.
We hit record at our kitchen table to share the raw reality of breaking the rules and designing a fulfilling life.

After a decade building companies at the frontier of technology, I’ve learned that the most important question isn’t only what can we build, but why - and what kind of future do we want to create?
Crossing disciplines, I speak with leading voices across technology, film, music, art, architecture, biology and philosophy to expand our imagination of what’s possible, and what it means to be human.

title: Best Day Gone Wrong

description:
Every destination has two stories.
Some inspire us… Others leave us with questions.
We explore what happens when dream vacations become nightmares. From travel disasters to tourist scams, we travel the world uncovering the darker side of the places millions visit every year - breaking down the evidence, timelines, and "what went wrong".
✨ Expect:
• True crime from around the world

title: The Bungalow Mystery (A Nancy Drew Mystery)
author: Mildred Wirt Benson
description:
When a sudden storm traps Nancy Drew on a secluded lake, her instincts kick into high gear. In *Bungalow Mystery, Version 2*, Nancy faces one of her most thrilling challenges yet as she races against time to uncover the truth behind her friend Laura’s mysterious guardian. With danger lurking at every turn, Nancy must navigate treacherous waters—both literally and figuratively—to rescue Laura from a web of deceit.

As Nancy delves deeper into this gripping mystery, she uncovers clues that point to a much larger conspiracy. What secrets lie hidden within the walls of the bungalow? Why does Laura’s guardian seem to have a sinister agenda? Listeners will find themselves on the edge of their seats as Nancy employs her sharp wit and resourcefulness to untangle the threads of this complex case.

Join Nancy on her high-speed chase filled with unexpected twists, clever deductions, and the unbreakable bonds of friendship. Will she outsmart the danger and save Laura in time? This audiobook captivates with its engaging narrative, inviting young listeners to embrace the thrill of solving mysteries alongside their favorite sleuth. Perfect for fans of adventure and intrigue, *Bungalow Mystery* promises an unforgettable ride packed with suspense and heart.

title: My Anecdotal Life
author: Granville Wyche Burgess
description:
My Anecdotal Life is a first-person limited podcast series that invites listeners into the world of Granville Wyche Burgess through his family stories, personal history, misadventures, struggles, and triumphs. 
Sometimes wonderful, sometimes awkward, and always dramatic, these stories trace Granville’s journey from boyhood in the 1950s American South to making his way in the wider world, and the lessons he did — and did not — learn. Funny, heartfelt, and deeply personal, the series showcases Granville’s gift for storytelling and the wit, wisdom, and candor that define his life.
Written and performed by Granville Wyche Burgess
Directed by Andrea Lynn Green
Recorded and edited by Dexter Frisch in Andrew’s Studio, Greenwich, CT
Mastered by Matthew Scott Johnston
Special thanks to Theatre Artists Workshop

She will not hold back on her opinion on anything or anyone. While talking to guests ranging anywhere from actors to comics to reality stars, Heather asks the juiciest questions you always want to be answered. title: AHS: 13 Official Podcast
author: FX
description:
FX’s “American Horror Story,” the global phenomenon that has garnered more than 100 Emmy nominations since its launch in 2011, returns for an unrivaled 13th installment that will do justice to everyone’s most feared number. Bringing together an all-star cast, many of whom are reprising fan favorite roles, “AHS: 13” continues to build on the anthology’s decades-long legacy that has been streamed more than 700 million hours across the globe and spawned a legion of dedicated fans. Created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk, “American Horror Story” has redefined the genre with various installments featuring a creepy murder house, a coven of witches, a traveling freak show, a haunted hotel and the apocalypse itself. Which iconic horrors will return to haunt the hallowed halls of 13 and what new terrors await? Light your candles, draw your pentagrams and prepare for a supreme surprise.

 

The AHS:13 Official Podcast features talent interviewing each other, including Sarah Paulson, Emma Roberts, Joey Pollari, Paul Anthony Kelly, and the lead costume and production designers including Lou Eyrich, Catherine Crabtree and Anu Schwartz.


The Official Podcast is produced by FX in partnership with AT WILL MEDIA.

She addresses internet rumors and untruths, current events, and LGBTQ+ issues, framing everything from the perspective of addressing the same old, tired arguments heard every day. What makes her unique? Other than completely unfiltered quips, quirky humor, foul language, and a touch of passion and love for people, not too much. title: The Tale of Little Pig Robinson (A Charming Animal Adventure)
author: Beatrix Potter
description:
Robinson, the little pig, finds himself adrift in a tiny boat, far from home and safety. Sent to market by his two overbearing aunts—who are too plump to make the journey themselves—Robinson’s adventure begins with uncertainty and a cheeky sense of humor. As he navigates the challenges of the wide-open world, listeners will join him on a delightful journey filled with unexpected twists and whimsical encounters.

In this enchanting retelling inspired by Edward Lear’s beloved poem, Beatrix Potter weaves a tale that blends comedy and curiosity. What dangers await Robinson on his voyage? How will he manage to outsmart the obstacles in his path? As our heroic pig grapples with the realities of independence, he discovers not just the thrill of adventure but the importance of courage and cunning.

This audiobook is perfect for animal lovers and fans of classic children’s literature. Potter’s unique storytelling brings the world of Little Pig Robinson to life, inviting listeners of all ages to revel in his charm and resilience. Join Robinson as he learns valuable life lessons amidst laughter, mischief, and the heartwarming camaraderie of friends met along the way. Will he find his way back home, or will he embrace a new life on the high seas? Tune in to uncover the delightful surprises that await!

And how we sometimes use travel to help us navigate through life in our own way. Every single week Mike will be coming to you from an entirely unique location. Sometimes a castle. Sometimes a clifftop. Sometimes a car. If you're looking for something "produced" from a studio you are in the wrong place. If you're looking for something fun, real, raw and authentic. title: The Succession Strategy
author: Vincent Caruso
description:
Over the next decade, around one-third of Australia's 1.4 million business owners are expected to retire. Yet an estimated 467,000 Australian businesses still don't have a succession plan in place. In family run businesses and regional areas this equates to almost 80% of all businesses. Join us as we explore the conversations, strategies, and expert insights that help business owners plan with confidence for what's next.
If you have questions or would like to learn more about planning the future of your business, we'd love to hear from you. Until next time, remember: the best succession plans don't just protect businesses—they protect families, legacies, and the future.

author: E.R Burroughs
description:
Alexis Paulvitch, vengeful and cunning, plots to exact revenge on Tarzan, the legendary Lord of the Jungle. In "Son of Tarzan," the tension escalates as Paulvitch kidnaps Tarzan's son, Korak, seeking to draw the mighty ape-man into a deadly game of cat and mouse. What begins as a father’s desperate search quickly turns into a thrilling adventure filled with danger and unexpected alliances.

Listeners will be swept away as they follow Korak’s transformative journey from a sheltered young man to a fierce warrior, navigating the wilds of Africa and unearthing secrets that challenge his very identity. Along the way, he encounters treacherous foes, loyal friends, and the primal beauty of the jungle, all while grappling with the legacy of his father.

Burroughs masterfully crafts a narrative that explores themes of bravery, loyalty, and the quest for self-discovery. With each twist and turn, the stakes rise, leaving listeners on the edge of their seats, eager to uncover how Korak will confront his destiny.

Dive into this action-packed adventure that captures the essence of the Tarzan saga, revealing the enduring bond between father and son amidst the chaos of the wild. Will Korak rise to the challenge, or will he fall victim to his enemies' schemes? Join the quest and find out!

description:
When Tarzan stumbles upon a hidden civilization of tiny warriors known as the Minunians, he finds himself thrust into a battle for survival and understanding. These fierce little people, with their own customs and conflicts, present both a challenge and an opportunity for the legendary lord of the jungle. As Tarzan navigates their world, he grapples with the balance between power and wisdom, forcing him to confront not only their warlike nature but his own instincts as a protector.

Throughout this gripping audiobook, listeners will journey alongside Tarzan as he uncovers the mysteries of the Minunians, whose intricate society is filled with surprising twists and turns. Will he ally with them against a common enemy, or will his outsider status prove too great a barrier? The stakes escalate as Tarzan encounters not just physical battles but moral dilemmas that test his character and resolve.

Edgar Rice Burroughs crafts a tale rich with adventure, exploring themes of identity, loyalty, and the essence of civilization. Join Tarzan in this action-packed saga that challenges not only his physical prowess but his understanding of humanity itself. Prepare for unexpected alliances and fierce confrontations that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Dive into 'Tarzan and the Ant Men'—where every encounter could change the fate of two worlds.

title: Blood at Dawn
author: Fire Eyes Media LLC
description:
On October 12, 1996, Kevin Carroll, Keith Chavez, and Donald Mikesh Jr. were brutally beaten and murdered inside a condominium on Chicago’s Southwest Side. Three people were arrested. Three people were convicted. Each was sentenced to three concurrent life sentences in prison.

The case may have ended in convictions, but nearly 30 years later, the story is far from over...

Blood at Dawn is a multipart true crime series hosted by Heather, Kevin Carroll’s daughter. She was just 13 years old when her father was killed. Now, for the first time, she is going back through the case that changed her life. Using court testimony, police records, and interviews with family members and people closely involved in the investigation, Heather reconstructs the hours leading up to the murders. She examines the investigation and trials that followed, as well as the conflicting stories told by the three people convicted of the crime. But this story did not end when the verdicts were read.

Blood at Dawn explores what happens to the families left behind once the headlines disappear and everyone else moves on. They are expected to live with what happened. Then, decades later, they discover that the people convicted are asking the state for mercy.

Nearly 30 years after her father walked into that condominium and never walked out, Heather is returning to the evidence, the memories, and the questions that never completely went away.

This time, she is telling the story...

How do you adopt AI without exposing sensitive data? Who owns AI risk? How should organizations govern AI agents and identities? And how do you put sensible controls around rapidly changing technology without making it so difficult to use that people simply find another way?

Drawing on real-world experience, emerging research and conversations with technology and security leaders, AI Security Multipliers explores AI, cybersecurity, data, identity, risk and governance in practical terms.

Award-winning podcasters Sean Kipe and Jason Hoch bring Melissa’s exclusive story and explosive new details to the 51-year kidnapping saga.

Evan Transue was an atheist and general skeptic from a very young age. Whether you were a Christian, Muslim, Buddhist, or a believer in UFOs/Aliens, he thought the exact same thing about you - you must be nuts.

Do you have a problem? Of course you do - you're human (we hope, otherwise we're scared).


In this comedy podcast, married couple Ari and Ad solve all your burning issues, from whether to dump your boyfriend who keeps announcing he's 'the prize' during sex, to what to do if you're worried your neighbour is plotting revenge because of the angle you left your bins at last week.


If you want your life fixed in a funny, sweary way, email your problems in confidence to ariandadfixyourlife@gmail.com. We promise to make you as happy as we are in this photo.

title: Art Harrison: Work, Life and Starting Over
author: Art Harrison
description:
I'm Art Harrison. I've started businesses, sold one, made some expensive mistakes, and found plenty of ways to get in my own way.
These are short, true stories about work, money, ambition, relationships, and starting over. I talk about what happened, what I thought I was doing, and what I make of it now. Sometimes there's something useful in the gap.
For anyone building something, changing direction, or trying to work out what they actually want from the life they're working so hard to build.

title: Cats, Tea, & Me
author: Dianne Pyda
description: My life has always been centered around learning and creating. As a kid, I would build structures out of mud, rocks, and sticks- really anything I could find laying around the house or yard. Then I joined 4H, and began to sew my own clothes, bake, and craft deliberately with materials like wood, leather, and string. That fostered my love of imagination, creation, and art. I wish to authentically share with you the nuggets of knowledge I've learned along my crazy path of life. Sometimes it's art, and sometimes it's just life; but it's always using the superpowers of imagination and creativity.

title: The Carbon Close
author: Parsepoint
description: The Carbon Close is a weekly, under-ten-minute podcast from Parsepoint for sustainability leaders at multi-location companies. Each episode examines one failure between the utility bill and the reported number, then gives you one practical control to test before the next reporting cycle. No generic climate news. No broad software tour.

title: Good News For Real
author: Pastor Jim Szakacs
description: A theologically liberal and progressive collection of messages presented by retired United Methodist pastor, Jim Szakacs. His unique pre-ministry background of entertainment marketing, event production, and even law enforcement make for an interesting perspective and scriptural interpretation that resonates with today’s Christian. Whether you  are new to the teaching of Jesus, or have been around the church for awhile, you will find his presentation style fun, inspiring, and thought provoking.

title: The Follow Up
author: New Community Church of West Michigan
description:
The Follow Up is a weekly podcast from New Community Church that continues the conversation beyond Sunday. Join us as we unpack the week's sermon, dive deeper into Scripture, and explore what it looks like to follow Jesus in everyday life.
Join us as we Accept. Connect. Walk Together. in Jesus, equipping Bible-Based disciples.

title: Inner Noor
author: Zaynah Ayan
description: This podcast serves as a safe space for Muslim women to reconnect with the radiance Allah placed within each of us. Through faith-centered reminders and social science research, we explore the inner work of growing with self-compassion and what it means to feel grounded in ourselves as we navigate the world around us. I invite you to unleash your inner noor and step fully into your light. Bismillah...

title: DTA Science
author: DTA Science
description:
Down to a Science highlights practitioners across science, technology, and business to understand their personal insights and how their work impacts our world. What are they working on? Why does it matter? And what does it take to put new ideas into practice?
Technical enough to dig in. Informal enough to follow a good tangent. For curious scientists and practitioners figuring out what’s next; for the field and for themselves.

From handling rejection and embracing a growth mindset to developing daily habits that foster mental toughness, this podcast provides actionable insights to help elevate your mindset, thrive in your careers, and reach new heights in life.

title: Faith Meets Action | How to Set Goals, Journaling Prompts, Trust in God
author: Gretchen Greene - Goal Setting & Life Planning Coach for Christian Women
description:
Do you feel like everyone else has their life figured out except you? Are you constantly wondering what God is calling you to do, praying for clarity, or afraid of making the wrong decision? Maybe you’re in a season of transition— changing careers, moving, graduating, starting over, or simply wondering what’s next.
If that sounds like you, I’m so glad you’re here! This podcast was created for Christian women in their 20s who desire a life filled with purpose, peace, confidence, and meaningful work. 
Hi, I’m Gretchen. I’m a Jesus lover, entrepreneur, and former overthinker who knows what it feels like to have big dreams but feel unsure of the next step.
For years, I felt overwhelmed trying to figure out my next move, searching for clarity, and making decisions without knowing how to fully trust God through the process.
I realized I didn’t need the perfect plan—I needed to surrender my timeline, release the fear of getting it wrong, and take the next step in faith.
I learned how to create a plan that aligned with my faith and the life I wanted to build. Simple goals, intentional steps, and the confidence to move forward even when I didn’t have all the answers. And I’m ready to share it with you!
If you are ready to: 
Stop feeling stuck and start confidently moving toward the life God is calling you to...
Learn simple goal-setting and planning strategies that bring clarity to your next steps...
Begin a faith-filled approach to decision-making, purpose, and building a fulfilled life - this podcast is for you!
Grab your journal, say a prayer, and let’s take the next faithful step together.

title: New Jersey Women's Clubs
author: NJSFWC
description: New Jersey Women’s Clubs is a podcast dedicated to the NJ State Federation of Women’s Clubs (NJSFWC). We are part of the General Federation of Women’s Clubs, an international philanthropic organization with 60,000+ members in affiliate clubs across all 50 states, Washington DC, & more than 12 countries. In NJ, we have approximately 150 clubs and 6000 members throughout our state. Our mission is to provide opportunities for education, leadership training, & community service through participation in local clubs & statewide projects, enabling members to make a difference in the lives of others.

title: LIVIN LIVE PODCAST
author: W.E. Osley III
description: LIVIN LIVE is a truth therapy session with the cameras rolling. Every week W.E. Osley III sits down with an ordinary person and asks the questions most people never get asked out loud. What shaped you. What broke you. What you did about it. Guests have walked in off a prison sentence, out of a twenty year silence, off a football field, and into the chair. They talk about adversity, addiction, faith, fatherhood, mental health, second chances and the quiet decisions that turn a life around. There is no panel of experts here and no script. There is one host who listens, one guest who tells the truth, and a room in downtown Tampa where nobody is in a hurry. New episodes every Saturday. Watch the full video on YouTube at @LivinLivePodcastShow. LIVIN LIVE THE ROUNDTABLE, the companion show where Will sits with a table of friends and works through one real question, drops between episodes. Recorded at FuturEdge Strategies Studios, downtown Tampa, Florida. A FuturEdge Strategies production.

title: The Medicine Between the Lines
author: Aiden
description: The Medicine Between the Lines is a general-audience educational podcast exploring the fascinating world of medicines, healthcare, pharmacology, prevention, medication safety, and the science behind modern treatment. Each episode turns complicated medical ideas into clear, engaging conversations about how medicines work, why they are prescribed, how they are developed, and why responsible medicine use matters.

title: Making Space: Real Time with Chris Niesen
author: ARC - The Association of Retail & Consumer Professionals
description: Physical retail isn’t standing still—and neither is Making Space: Real Time. Every two weeks, retail strategist Chris Niesen goes beyond the headlines to unpack the store formats, remodels, capital investments, and category decisions transforming the retail floor. Drawing on firsthand experience from thousands of store visits and coverage of more than 450 retailers and brands, Chris delivers candid, practitioner-led insight into what’s working, what isn’t, and why it matters. Expect sharp analysis, informed conversations, and a little fun as Chris is joined by expert co-hosts from across retail, space planning, and visual merchandising. Subscribe and get a real-time view of the ideas and decisions shaping physical retail. Presented by the Association of Retail and Consumer Professionals (ARC) in partnership with Omni Talk.

description: In this series we feature interviews with women in leadership and on leadership tracks on topics such as the gender pay gap (including ethnicity and disability), and the experiences of young women around pay/leadership, Governance, and international experience.

title: Stepping into Your Magic
author: Tiffany Egbert
description: Stepping Into Your Magic is a podcast for creatives, seekers, and soul-led humans who want to live and create with more depth, wonder, and trust in themselves. Through inspiring conversations with artists, mindfulness teachers, and wellness coaches, we explore creativity, healing, intuition, spirituality, and the courage to fully be yourself.

title: Inside the Comics
author: Liam J. Holland
description:
Inside the Comics explores the stories, creators and ideas behind comic books and graphic novels. Hosted by Liam J. Holland, the show goes beyond reviews, rankings and weekly news to look at how comics are made, why certain stories connect with readers, and the people shaping the medium. Each episode features conversations with comic writers, artists, editors and other creators, alongside roundtable discussions, deep dives and occasional documentary-style episodes. From Marvel and DC to creator-owned comics, independent publishers, British comics and European graphic novels, Inside the Comics looks across the wider world of sequential art — past, present and future.Expect:
• Interviews with comic book writers, artists and creators
• Deep dives into major comics, characters and publishing trends
• Discussions about the craft and business of making comics
• Independent and creator-owned comics
• British and European comics
• Comic book history and forgotten stories
• Convention coverage and behind-the-scenes conversations. If you love comics and want to understand more about the people and ideas behind them, subscribe and come Inside the Comics.

title: Psychology and You
author: Psychology and You - Podcast
description:
Hey There! Welcome to Psychology & You – The Podcast for You.
We’re Debby and Hannah, friends since birth, and both trained in clinical psychology. We’ve spent countless hours talking about how our minds work, how society shapes us, and how psychology shows up in everyday life.
In this podcast, we break down evidence-based psychology from happiness and relationships to the questions we all quietly ask ourselves. We share the theory, the latest research, and most importantly: what you can actually do with it.
So welcome to Psychology & You — let’s be curious and figure it out together.
